strings.text: Two high school counselors, one for public and independent schools and one for boarding — a structure the school added in 2023-24.
strings.t: مرشدتان لالتحاق طلاب المرحلة الثانوية، إحداهما للمدارس الحكومية والمستقلّة والأخرى للمدارس الداخلية — وهي بنية أضافتها المدرسة في 2023-24.

strings.text: Trinity frames the K–8 model as choosing a high school at the end of 8th grade rather than at the start of Kindergarten.
strings.t: تطرح Trinity نموذج K–8 على أنه اختيار مدرسة ثانوية في نهاية الصف الثامن بدلًا من اختيارها في بداية رياض الأطفال.

strings.text: high school counsellors, by published scope
strings.t: مرشدتان للمرحلة الثانوية، بحسب النطاق المنشور
من رياض الأطفال حتى الصف الثامن

strings.text: years on one campus before the search begins
strings.t: سنوات في حرم واحد قبل أن يبدأ البحث

strings.text: Throughout Middle School — knowing the schools
strings.t: طوال Middle School — التعرّف على المدارس

strings.text: The counsellor for public and independent placement visits area schools and, in her words, gets “a feel for who might benefit from knowing this school,” then points families toward fits based on what they want: “Do they want big class sizes? Are sports important? Extracurricular?”
strings.t: تزور المرشدة المسؤولة عن الالتحاق بالمدارس الحكومية والمستقلّة مدارس المنطقة، وتكوّن على حدّ تعبيرها “a feel for who might benefit from knowing this school,” ثم توجّه الأسر إلى الخيارات المناسبة بحسب ما تريده: “Do they want big class sizes? Are sports important? Extracurricular?”

strings.text: Middle School — the boarding track, if a family wants it
strings.t: Middle School — مسار المدارس الداخلية، إن أرادته الأسرة

strings.text: Boarding placement is handled separately and by a different person. It is not a marginal path here: 12% of all graduates since 2004 went to boarding schools, and the destination list includes Deerfield, Lawrenceville, Mercersburg, Woodberry Forest, St. Paul’s and The Taft School.
strings.t: يُدار الالتحاق بالمدارس الداخلية بشكل منفصل وعلى يد شخص آخر. وهو ليس مسارًا هامشيًّا هنا: فـ 12% من جميع الخرّيجين منذ 2004 التحقوا بمدارس داخلية، وتضمّ قائمة الوجهات Deerfield وLawrenceville وMercersburg وWoodberry Forest وSt. Paul’s وThe Taft School.

strings.text: The school’s stated case is that nine years of one faculty knowing a child produces a better-informed choice: parents “feel more confident about finding the high school that’s best suited for their child at the end of 8th Grade rather than at the beginning of Kindergarten.”
strings.t: حجّة المدرسة المعلنة هي أن تسع سنوات يعرف فيها كادرٌ واحد الطفل تُنتج اختيارًا أفضل استنارةً: فالآباء “feel more confident about finding the high school that’s best suited for their child at the end of 8th Grade rather than at the beginning of Kindergarten.”

strings.text: Ninety-five named high schools across 23 graduating classes — and ten of them have their own dossier here.
strings.t: خمس وتسعون مدرسة ثانوية مذكورة بالاسم عبر 23 دفعة تخرّج — وعشر منها لها ملفّها الخاص هنا.

strings.text: This is the school’s own cumulative list for the Classes of 2004–2026, grouped by what each destination actually is. It is a list of names only: the school publishes no per-school counts and no per-year attribution, so no destination should be read as “N students went there”.
strings.t: هذه هي القائمة التراكمية الخاصة بالمدرسة لدفعات 2004–2026، مصنّفة بحسب طبيعة كل وجهة. وهي قائمة أسماء فقط: فالمدرسة لا تنشر أعدادًا لكل مدرسة ولا نسبةً لكل سنة، لذا لا ينبغي قراءة أي وجهة على أنها “N students went there”.

strings.text: 97% of the Class of 2026 were accepted into one or both of their top two high school choices — and Charlotte Prep has published a rate like it for every class since 2023.

strings.text: A dedicated placement team, a twelve-step path that starts before 8th grade, and a fall fair that brings over 40 high schools to campus to recruit.
strings.t: فريق مخصّص للالتحاق بالمرحلة الثانوية، ومسار من اثنتي عشرة خطوة يبدأ قبل الصف 8، ومعرض في الخريف يجلب أكثر من 40 مدرسة ثانوية إلى الحرم المدرسي لاستقطاب الطلاب.

strings.text: The application is parent-driven, but the school manages the rest: "Our team manages all other aspects of the process to minimize stress and provide all necessary materials."
strings.t: يقود الوالدان عملية التقديم، لكن المدرسة تتولّى الباقي: "Our team manages all other aspects of the process to minimize stress and provide all necessary materials."

strings.t: اختبار القبول الوحيد الذي تسمّيه المدرسة

strings.text: Spring of 7th grade — the Parent Coffee
"Each spring, rising 8th-grade parents attend a Parent Coffee to learn about the admissions process, events, deadlines, and other tips and information to prepare for the year ahead."
strings.t: "Each spring, rising 8th-grade parents attend a Parent Coffee to learn about the admissions process, events, deadlines, and other tips and information to prepare for the year ahead."

strings.text: Students sit the Independent School Entrance Exam for practice in 7th grade, then for high school placement in 8th, and the school provides ISEE test preparation in between: "Students learn test-taking strategies and prepare for admissions testing to gain comfort and fine tune skills."
strings.t: يؤدّي الطلاب اختبار Independent School Entrance Exam للتدريب في الصف 7، ثم للالتحاق بالمرحلة الثانوية في الصف 8، وتوفّر المدرسة بينهما تحضيرًا لاختبار ISEE: "Students learn test-taking strategies and prepare for admissions testing to gain comfort and fine tune skills."

strings.text: September of 8th grade — the High School Fair
strings.t: سبتمبر من الصف 8 — High School Fair

strings.text: "In September, administrators from over 40 schools are invited to Charlotte Prep's High School Fair and Boarding School Fair to recruit our students." The boarding fair includes a panel discussion — one 2026 family credits it with their decision to pursue boarding school.
strings.t: "In September, administrators from over 40 schools are invited to Charlotte Prep's High School Fair and Boarding School Fair to recruit our students." ويتضمّن معرض المدارس الداخلية حلقة نقاش — وتنسب إليها إحدى أسر 2026 قرارها بالتوجّه إلى مدرسة داخلية.

strings.text: Fall of 8th grade — meetings and school visits

The team meets individually with each 8th grader and separately with each student's parents "to discuss their plans, their objectives for their child, and appropriate placement opportunities." Families are encouraged to visit open houses and tours, and students make day visits to the schools on their list.
strings.t: يجتمع الفريق فرديًا بكل طالب في الصف 8، وبشكل منفصل بوالدَي كل طالب "to discuss their plans, their objectives for their child, and appropriate placement opportunities." وتُشجَّع الأسر على حضور الأيام المفتوحة والجولات، ويقوم الطلاب بزيارات نهارية للمدارس المدرجة في قائمتهم.

strings.text: "In Leadership class, students learn interview etiquette and conduct. They learn about proper dress, eye contact, handshake, and what to look for as they seek the school that fits them best." Teachers and administrators run mock interviews, and the brochure adds a practice interview with the head of school.
strings.t: "In Leadership class, students learn interview etiquette and conduct. They learn about proper dress, eye contact, handshake, and what to look for as they seek the school that fits them best." ويُجري المعلّمون والإداريون مقابلات تجريبية، ويضيف الكتيّب مقابلة تدريبية مع رئيس المدرسة.

strings.text: Winter of 8th grade — applications and advocacy

"Charlotte Prep electronically delivers our students' complete transcripts and teacher recommendation packets to the schools prior to deadlines." The team then meets with each high school "for in-depth conversations about our student applicants and to provide further insight to ensure each student is well known."
strings.t: "Charlotte Prep electronically delivers our students' complete transcripts and teacher recommendation packets to the schools prior to deadlines." ثم يجتمع الفريق بكل مدرسة ثانوية "for in-depth conversations about our student applicants and to provide further insight to ensure each student is well known."
